entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We got out of the car and walked to..."
entries.dialogueText: We got out of the car and walked towards the entrance of the building, escorted by our guards. Besides our own security forces, I noticed a heavy police presence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The buildings around the plaza were..."
entries.dialogueText: The buildings around the plaza were decorated with a comically large amount of Sordish flags. Everywhere I looked, I saw a sea of maroon, white and gold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the entrance, Kesaro Kibener, th..."
entries.dialogueText: At the entrance, Kesaro Kibener, the head of the National Front Party, was waiting for us in his iconic brown suit, together with a group of local policemen.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Huh. I thought we arrived way too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Huh. I thought we arrived way too early. Looks like our host -- the devil himself -- is already expecting us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We got out of the car and walked to..."
entries.dialogueText: We got out of the car and walked towards the entrance of the building, escorted by our guards.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Why is he even in the spotlight? H..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why is he even in the spotlight? He's acting like he still governs the city."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honestly, I'm already regretting m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, I'm already regretting my decision to come here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be fair, his party still does.""
entries.dialogueText: "To be fair, his party still does."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's a dangerously competent man,..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's a dangerously competent man, Petr. We should be cautious with him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He can act however he wants, Petr...."
entries.dialogueText: "He can act however he wants, Petr. He is not a threat to us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, it was Lucian's idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, it was Lucian's idea."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope so."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah, that's true.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, that's true."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Thank you for being here so early..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for being here so early on this glorious day, Mr. President and Mr. Vice President."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""As the former mayor of Jen, it is..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the former mayor of Jen, it is an honor to welcome you to our fine city."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is good to be here.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is good to be here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We shook hands."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Kibener.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It looks like you did a good job...."
entries.dialogueText: "It looks like you did a good job. Maybe you should think about running for local office again."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Thanks for the kind words, but I'l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the kind words, but I'll do an even better job as president. Besides, as you can see, our current mayor doesn't need my help."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Thank you for organizing this, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for organizing this, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply and simply shook hi..."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply and simply shook his hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seeing us arrive, Kesaro approached..."
entries.dialogueText: Seeing us arrive, Kesaro approached us with a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro pointed at the center of the..."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro pointed at the center of the plaza where a stage had been erected. He gestured at the blazing sun above us.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""It'll still be a while before the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll still be a while before the stage is ready. Why don't we find somewhere away from the sun?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Let's brighten up a little. It's V..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's brighten up a little. It's Victory Day today."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Mr. Vice President?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sure. I'll take one too.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. I'll take one too."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After passing one more cigarette to..."
entries.dialogueText: After passing one more cigarette to Petr, he lit them up.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I just wanted to use this opportun..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to use this opportunity to make some comments on the administration."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""It isn't everyday that one sees th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It isn't everyday that one sees the president and the vice president together, let alone have a conversation with them. Surely you'd understand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course, Mr. Kibener. I understa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. Kibener. I understand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, there's nothing better to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, there's nothing better to do right now. Go ahead and make your comments if you have to."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll be very honest. I don't want..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be very honest. I don't want to hear your comments. Please keep them to yourself."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Kibener. I apprecia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Kibener. I appreciate your supportive words."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm glad you approve. And frankly,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you approve. And frankly, I don't think you and I are so different from each other."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mr. Kibener, but I don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Kibener, but I don't need either your sympathy or your support."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you serious? *Not enough*? It'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you serious? *Not enough*? It's an emergency, Mr. Kibener. What more can I do?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I meant no offense, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "I meant no offense, Mr. President. You've done wonders to neutralize the Red Youth. But the Bludish separatists are just as dangerous as the commies, if not more."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I meant no offense, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "I meant no offense, Mr. President. You've done wonders to neutralize the separatists. But the Red Youth is as equally dangerous as the Bluds."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""If only something could be done ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only something could be done against them as well..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You'll be making a grave mistake i..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be making a grave mistake if you keep supporting terrorists like the Young Sords, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Just because you label them a terr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just because you label them a terrorist organization doesn't make them one, Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""That's for you to decide.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's for you to decide."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was a necessary decision. That'..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a necessary decision. That's all I can say."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mistakes were made, but the past i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mistakes were made, but the past is in the past."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Am I supposed to be impressed with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Am I supposed to be impressed with these theatrics?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""It was hardly a *necessary* decisi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was hardly a *necessary* decision, Mr. President. You know that."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I'm glad you agree. But the wrongs..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you agree. But the wrongs of the past can still be undone by others."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed and looked at me with nar..."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed and looked at me with narrowed eyes.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I want to ask you to reconsider th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to ask you to reconsider the targets of the emergency. It is still not too late."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I'll be clear. You can still make..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be clear. You can still make it up to us. And I think you should take that opportunity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what if I don't?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what if I don't?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Young Sords orchestrated an at..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Young Sords orchestrated an attack at the Maroon Palace and murdered a member of the Assembly in cold blood. There is nothing to reconsider here."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't act like you have the upper..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't act like you have the upper hand, Mr. Kibener. You are the one who should make it up to me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""No need for premature assumptions,..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for premature assumptions, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Let's not imagine that scenario, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not imagine that scenario, Mr. President. Let me explain."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Yes, yes. A justified purge. A cla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, yes. A justified purge. A classic campaign of anti-Sordist propaganda from the establishment. I get it."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""We know how it goes. Hire a mental..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know how it goes. Hire a mentally damaged individual to wreak societal havoc and blame a whole group of individuals for it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Isn't it ironic that you're the on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't it ironic that you're the one who's saying this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're the one putting undue blame..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the one putting undue blame on minorities. Particularly the Bludish community."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sorry but I don't agree with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry but I don't agree with that. The establishment is more aligned with your ideology than anything else."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Are you saying I'm a hypocrite? Pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you saying I'm a hypocrite? Perhaps I am."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Maybe it does seem that way from y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe it does seem that way from your perspective. Doesn't mean it's the truth."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Nonetheless, none of that matters..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless, none of that matters if you cannot hold onto your newly attained powers."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Your emergency act may have you fe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your emergency act may have you feeling invincible, but there are forces grander than you that are set on your destruction."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I'll be straight with you. Your po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be straight with you. Your politics or intentions don't matter if you cannot hold onto your newly attained powers."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You cannot speak that way to the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot speak that way to the president, Mr. Kibener. I hope -- for your sake -- that wasn't a threat."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I'll be straight with you. Your po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be straight with you. Your politics or intentions don't matter if you cannot hold onto your newly attained powers."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Vice President is right. Be ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President is right. Be careful with your choice of words, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's okay, Petr. I want to know wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay, Petr. I want to know where he'll go with this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think you're forgetting that we'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you're forgetting that we're in an emergency. I advise you not to bite off any more than you can chew."
entries.menuText: (Point at your armed security.) "I think you're forgetting that we're in an emergency. I advise you not to bite off any more than you can chew."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pointed at the heavily armed secu..."
entries.dialogueText: I pointed at the heavily armed security forces that followed us from a distance. Kesaro took a long look at them and turned to us, smiling.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Now, that was an actual threat. Wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, that was an actual threat. Wouldn't you agree, Mr. Vectern?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Petr nodded.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I actually wanted you to meet some..."
entries.dialogueText: "I actually wanted you to meet someone. We both have much to discuss with you. He'll be here any second now."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""What would be a more fitting act o..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would be a more fitting act on such a day of unity than the establishment of mutual respect and cooperation?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I wish people would focus more on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish people would focus more on actions than words. But I will do my best."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well... Feel free to file a lawsui..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... Feel free to file a lawsuit, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro laughed."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro laughed.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""As I said... The president is far..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said... The president is far from safe during this emergency. I am aware of the fissures forming between the administration and the Supreme Court. The Old Guard have you at their whim."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I just wanted to confirm whether y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to confirm whether you are insistent on committing your own political suicide or not."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not going to entertain you by..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to entertain you by taking part in your word games, Mr. Kibener."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You've heard wrong. There are no c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've heard wrong. There are no cracks between us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why would you care if it is a poli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would you care if it is a political suicide for me?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The answer is: I am not. I am awar..."
entries.dialogueText: "The answer is: I am not. I am aware of the threat the Court poses but I won't be intimidated by it."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I'm an honest man, so don't get me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm an honest man, so don't get me wrong. If it was only about you or the USP, I wouldn't care at all."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""But if the nationalist movement is..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if the nationalist movement is getting the short end of the stick in this process, then we have a problem."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Suit yourself, Mr. Rayne. But hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suit yourself, Mr. Rayne. But hear me out."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Yes... I'm sure there aren't.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I'm sure there aren't."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Is that supposed to be noble?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that supposed to be noble?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Look. I never questioned your cour..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look. I never questioned your courage. Your logic, on the other hand..."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Our suggestion is to finally enfor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our suggestion is to finally enforce the official language of our country as stated in the constitution."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""We are working on the Unified Lang..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are working on the Unified Language Act. It is directly aimed at the breeding grounds of the Bludish Freedom Front."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""The bill will give the state a way..."
entries.dialogueText: "The bill will give the state a way to control the radicalization in these schools that teach Bludish nationalist propaganda. Without taking any rights away."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I believe we already have the supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe we already have the support of all the patriots within the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You seem very confident.""
entries.dialogueText: "You seem very confident."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""The police have infiltrated 32 BFF..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police have infiltrated 32 BFF training grounds in remote towns around Bergia that posed as middle schools. Despite all the evidence, similar schools keep popping up."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""And so-called activists are consta..."
entries.dialogueText: "And so-called activists are constantly blocking Governor Bron's attempts to stop these schools, claiming he is attacking their *right to language*."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Even if the Assembly supports it,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if the Assembly supports it, I will surely be using my veto on it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll sign the bill if it reaches m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll sign the bill if it reaches me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll have to read it in detail to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have to read it in detail to decide if I can support it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, a man with a large build..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, a man with a large build in a brown suit approached us. When we turned to greet him, I realized he was Remus Holstron. The Deputy of the National Front Party.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""That shouldn't come as a surprise.""
entries.dialogueText: "That shouldn't come as a surprise."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""If I were you, I wouldn't stand in..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I were you, I wouldn't stand in the way of the majority, Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So you want the support of the USP?""
entries.dialogueText: "So you want the support of the USP?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Your emergency is directly aimed a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your emergency is directly aimed at the proud nationalists of this country, Mr. Rayne. People are finally waking up to it."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""You had your own justification, of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had your own justification, of course. A classic campaign of anti-Sordist propaganda from the establishment. I get it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Really, Mr. Kibener? When it's a B..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really, Mr. Kibener? When it's a Bludish person, it's Bludish terror, but when it's Sordish nationalists, it's a few mentally handicapped individuals?"

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""You made an enemy out of Sordish n..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made an enemy out of Sordish nationalists -- people who have the deepest love for this nation."

entries.dialogueText: I took a look at his lighter as he closed its lid. It was a regular Rippo, but its shape appeared to be malformed.

entries.title: Narrator: "Looking more closely, I could see a..."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
